query: Buatkan materi bahasa Arab tema السوق untuk kelas 7 MTs, 2 x 40 menit.
expected_behavior: States assumed defaults (level pemula, Indonesian explanation) without asking more than one round of questions
All Arabic in vocabulary, dialogue, examples and exercises is fully vocalized, including i'rab and tanwin
Every noun shows singular, plural and gender; every verb shows past, present and masdar
Dialogue speakers are the same gender and pronouns/verb forms agree with them
Exercises cover at least two of the four maharat and include a rubric for any speaking or writing task
Answer key is a separate section and matches the items one-to-one
Teacher-note timing adds up to exactly 80 minutes
No Persian letters (ی ک), tatweel or presentation forms; scripts/check_arabic.py reports 0 errors

query: Tolong buatkan 10 soal pilihan ganda mufradat tema المهنة untuk pemula, lengkap dengan kuncinya.
expected_behavior: Uses exercises-only mode and states which vocabulary the items assume
Each item has 3 options with plausible, homogeneous distractors from the same theme or a single targeted feature
The position of the correct option varies across items; no 'all/none of the above'
Each item has exactly one correct answer and the key lists answers in the same numbering
Arabic is fully vocalized; uncertain plurals or masdars are flagged with ⚠️

query: Make a slide outline to teach detached pronouns (الضمائر المنفصلة) to intermediate adult learners. Explanations in English, one 60-minute session.
expected_behavior: Uses the slide block format with separate RTL Arabic box and LTR translation box
Speaker notes are written in English
No slide has more than 6 lines of Arabic; one idea per slide
Student slides contain no answers; the key is in a separate teacher-only block
Harakat follow the intermediate rule (full harakat) and pronoun forms are correct for gender and number
Recommends an OFL Arabic font (e.g. Amiri, Noto Naskh Arabic, Scheherazade New) and RTL paragraph direction
